Pricing & Licensing FAQs

Do you charge per test, per run, or per execution?

Virtuoso pricing is based on authoring users and execution capacity (volume of parallels or of execution frequency). You're not penalized for writing more tests or increasing coverage.

How do I choose between Consumption and Capacity?

Consumption – you are starting out with AI native automated testing and/or you understand how many tests you want to build and run

Capacity – You plan to automate regression for large or multiple apps and don't want to by limited to a number of tests or executions

How are Agentic Test Generation and Composable Test Automation priced?

Both solutions are available with Consumption and Capacity subscriptions as chargeable “add-on’s”. Pricing depends on scope (number of applications, test volume, library size). We'll discuss this during the pricing conversation based on your specific needs.

Can I use both solutions together?

Yes. Many customers combine Agentic Test Generation for custom applications with Composable Test Automation for their enterprise cloud apps (D365, Salesforce, SAP).

What's included in support?

Both include support portal access, training, and documentation. Capacity adds a dedicated onboarding manager, priority response times, and migration guidance. Enterprise customers get dedicated CSM + Technical Architect support.

Is there a free trial or starter option?

Yes. We offer proof-of-value options so you can validate AI-native testing on your applications before committing to a wider rollout.

Which Applications best suit Virtuoso ?

Any and all browser based applications. Dynamic, integrated, data driven business applications where end-to-end testing is critical to business success.

Do I have to sign a long-term contract?

Standard contractual term is 12 months and we offer multi year terms with additional incentives.

Can I start small and expand later without re-negotiating everything?

Yes. All pricing models scale linearly as you add teams, users, or execution capacity. We agree on the structure upfront, so expansion is fast and predictable. Contact your sales rep or your Customer Success agent for more information.
Can I add solutions later if I start with just the core platform?

Absolutely. Many customers start with Consumption or Capacity for their core testing needs, then add Agentic Test Generation or Composable Test Automation when they're ready to accelerate specific workflows.

What cloud applications does Composable Test Automation support?

We have pre-built libraries for Dynamics 365, Salesforce, SAP, Oracle Cloud, and Workday. We can also build custom composable assets for other cloud applications with REST APIs.

Are training and certifications really included?

Yes. All customers get access to Virtuoso’s University with self-paced courses and certification programs. Capacity and Enterprise customers get additional hands-on enablement workshops.

Do you offer discounts for long-term commitments or volume?

Yes. We provide volume and term-based discounts for multi-year commitments, multi-team rollouts, or strategic partnerships.

What if we wish to move away from Virtuoso in the future?

 If you wish to leave Virtuoso, we'll help you exit cleanly, but our expansion rates suggest most customers grow usage once they see AI-native testing in action. Any test assets that have been created can be exported in various formats.

Is Virtuoso secure for enterprise and regulated environments?

Yes. Virtuoso is SOC 2 Type II compliant and designed for enterprise security requirements.

We support role-based access control, encrypted data handling, audit logs, and secure network configurations for regulated industries.

Does Virtuoso support cross-browser testing?

Yes. Virtuoso supports cross-browser testing across modern browsers, including Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari, with cloud-based execution at scale.

Can I run tests in parallel?

Absolutely. Parallel execution is a core strength:

Consumption: Auto-scaled cloud execution based on demand
Capacity: Dedicated parallel execution lanes with predictable throughput

Additional parallels can be added for peak release periods.

How is Virtuoso installed or deployed?

Virtuoso is available as:

SaaS – fastest time-to-value, fully managed
Secure Bridge – run tests inside private networks while using Virtuoso’s AI platform

Both options integrate seamlessly with CI/CD pipelines and enterprise tooling.

Will Virtuoso work with our existing CI/CD setup?

Yes. Virtuoso integrates with GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, and other CI tools. Tests can be triggered automatically on commits, pull requests, or deployments.

Ready to experience 10x faster testing? Talk to our solution experts today.
Talk to Sales

                    <h2 class="heading-small text-align-center semi">Pricing & Licensing FAQs<br></h2>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="grid-layout _1-card">
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff44502" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">Do you charge per test, per run, or per execution?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Virtuoso pricing is based on authoring users and execution capacity (volume of parallels or of execution frequency). You're not penalized for writing more tests or increasing coverage.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff4450e" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">How do I choose between Consumption and Capacity?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Consumption – you are starting out with AI native automated testing and/or you understand how many tests you want to build and run<br><br>Capacity – You plan to automate regression for large or multiple apps and don't want to by limited to a number of tests or executions<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff4451d" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">How are Agentic Test Generation and Composable Test Automation priced?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Both solutions are available with Consumption and Capacity subscriptions as chargeable “add-on’s”. Pricing depends on scope (number of applications, test volume, library size). We'll discuss this during the pricing conversation based on your specific needs.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff44529" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">Can I use both solutions together?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Yes. Many customers combine Agentic Test Generation for custom applications with Composable Test Automation for their enterprise cloud apps (D365, Salesforce, SAP).<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff44535" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">What's included in support?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Both include support portal access, training, and documentation. Capacity adds a dedicated onboarding manager, priority response times, and migration guidance. Enterprise customers get dedicated CSM + Technical Architect support.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff44541" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">Is there a free trial or starter option?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Yes. We offer proof-of-value options so you can validate AI-native testing on your applications before committing to a wider rollout.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff4454d" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">Which Applications best suit Virtuoso ?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Any and all browser based applications. Dynamic, integrated, data driven business applications where end-to-end testing is critical to business success.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff44559" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">Do I have to sign a long-term contract?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Standard contractual term is 12 months and we offer multi year terms with additional incentives.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff44565" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">Can I start small and expand later without re-negotiating everything?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Yes. All pricing models scale linearly as you add teams, users, or execution capacity. We agree on the structure upfront, so expansion is fast and predictable. Contact your sales rep or your Customer Success agent for more information.</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff44570" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">Can I add solutions later if I start with just the core platform?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Absolutely. Many customers start with Consumption or Capacity for their core testing needs, then add Agentic Test Generation or Composable Test Automation when they're ready to accelerate specific workflows.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff4457c" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">What cloud applications does Composable Test Automation support?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">We have pre-built libraries for Dynamics 365, Salesforce, SAP, Oracle Cloud, and Workday. We can also build custom composable assets for other cloud applications with REST APIs.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff44588" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">Are training and certifications really included?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Yes. All customers get access to Virtuoso’s University with self-paced courses and certification programs. Capacity and Enterprise customers get additional hands-on enablement workshops.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff44594" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">Do you offer discounts for long-term commitments or volume?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Yes. We provide volume and term-based discounts for multi-year commitments, multi-team rollouts, or strategic partnerships.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff445a0" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">What if we wish to move away from Virtuoso in the future?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq"> If you wish to leave Virtuoso, we'll help you exit cleanly, but our expansion rates suggest most customers grow usage once they see AI-native testing in action. Any test assets that have been created can be exported in various formats.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff445ac" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">Is Virtuoso secure for enterprise and regulated environments?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Yes. Virtuoso is SOC 2 Type II compliant and designed for enterprise security requirements.<br><br>We support role-based access control, encrypted data handling, audit logs, and secure network configurations for regulated industries.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff445bb" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">Does Virtuoso support cross-browser testing?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Yes. Virtuoso supports cross-browser testing across modern browsers, including Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari, with cloud-based execution at scale.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff445c7" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">Can I run tests in parallel?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Absolutely. Parallel execution is a core strength:<br><br>Consumption: Auto-scaled cloud execution based on demand<br>Capacity: Dedicated parallel execution lanes with predictable throughput<br><br>Additional parallels can be added for peak release periods.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff445db" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">How is Virtuoso installed or deployed?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Virtuoso is available as:<br><br>SaaS – fastest time-to-value, fully managed<br>Secure Bridge – run tests inside private networks while using Virtuoso’s AI platform<br><br>Both options integrate seamlessly with CI/CD pipelines and enterprise tooling.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="faq-item-v2">
                    <div data-w-id="9f5190ff-0ee3-a3c3-b9d3-1aaaaff445ef" class="faq-question">
                      <h5 class="heading-xsmall faq">Will Virtuoso work with our existing CI/CD setup?<br></h5>
                      <div class="faq_icon-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f1a8e281bd3433d5faa74f8/6749c82f1fb5c7ec53d6d490_Vector%20386ds.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="faq_icon"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="height: 0px;" class="faq-answer">
                      <div class="faq-answer-content">
                        <div class="text-size-regular faq">Yes. Virtuoso integrates with GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, and other CI tools. Tests can be triggered automatically on commits, pull requests, or deployments.<br></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
